import pandas as pd, numpy as np, gzip
from scipy.io import mmread
from scipy.optimize import nnls
from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu, ranksums

# Load data
sc = pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_counts.csv', index_col=0)
meta = pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv')
meta = meta.set_index('Unnamed: 0').loc[sc.index]
cts = sorted(meta['cell_type'].unique())
print('cell types', cts)
# profiles: average relative expression per cell type
lib = sc.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan)
sc_rel = sc.div(lib, axis=0).fillna(0)
profiles = np.vstack([sc_rel.loc[meta['cell_type']==ct].mean(axis=0).values for ct in cts]).T
# maybe filter marker genes? keep all for nnls
profiles = profiles / profiles.sum(axis=0, keepdims=True)

X = mmread('matrix.mtx.gz').tocsc() # genes x spots
barcodes = [line.strip() for line in gzip.open('barcodes.tsv.gz','rt')]
features = [line.strip().split('\\t')[1] for line in gzip.open('features.tsv.gz','rt')]
assert features == list(sc.columns)
# deconvolve each spot from raw counts as combination of probability profiles
coefs=[]; residual=[]
A=profiles
for j in range(X.shape[1]):
    y = np.asarray(X[:,j].todense()).ravel().astype(float)
    c,r = nnls(A, y)
    coefs.append(c); residual.append(r/np.linalg.norm(y) if np.linalg.norm(y)>0 else np.nan)
coefs=np.array(coefs)
fracs=coefs/coefs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
print('residual median range', np.nanmedian(residual), np.nanmin(residual), np.nanmax(residual))
print(pd.DataFrame(fracs, columns=cts).describe().T[['mean','std','min','25%','50%','75%','max']])
print('dominant counts')
print(pd.Series(np.array(cts)[fracs.argmax(1)]).value_counts())

# positions
pos=pd.read_csv('tissue_positions.csv')
pos=pos.set_index('barcode').loc[barcodes]
coords=pos[['array_row','array_col']].astype(float).values
pix=pos[['pxl_row_in_fullres','pxl_col_in_fullres']].astype(float).values
# Store for further inspection
pd.DataFrame(fracs, index=barcodes, columns=cts).to_csv('nnls_spot_fractions.csv')

# Try threshold definitions for containing: fractions > thresholds; compare distance to nearest tumor-containing spot for spots containing ct vs not containing ct (excluding Tumor_Core spots? include?)
for thr in [0.01,0.025,0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2,0.3,0.5]:
    tumor = fracs[:,cts.index('Tumor_Core')] > thr
    if tumor.sum()==0 or tumor.sum()==len(tumor): continue
    dist = cdist(coords, coords[tumor]).min(axis=1)
    print('\\nTHR',thr,'tumor spots',tumor.sum(),'dist summary all med',np.median(dist),'max',dist.max())
    for ct in cts:
        if ct=='Tumor_Core': continue
        mask = fracs[:,cts.index(ct)] > thr
        if mask.sum()==0 or mask.sum()==len(mask):
            print(ct,'n',mask.sum())
            continue
        # maybe exclude tumor spots from testing ct proximity? compute both all and non-tumor
        u=mannwhitneyu(dist[mask], dist[~mask], alternative='less').pvalue
        print(ct,'n',mask.sum(),'med_in',np.median(dist[mask]),'med_out',np.median(dist[~mask]),'p_less',u)
PY"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, gzip
from scipy.io import mmread
from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu, spearmanr
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

sc=pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_counts.csv', index_col=0)
meta=pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv').set_index('Unnamed: 0').loc[sc.index]
cts=sorted(meta.cell_type.unique())
# log norm sc
sc_lib=sc.sum(1).replace(0,np.nan)
sc_log=np.log1p(sc.div(sc_lib, axis=0).fillna(0)*1e4)
# spatial log norm
X=mmread('matrix.mtx.gz').tocsc().T.toarray().astype(float) # spots x genes
barcodes=[l.strip() for l in gzip.open('barcodes.tsv.gz','rt')]
features=[l.strip().split('\\t')[1] for l in gzip.open('features.tsv.gz','rt')]
sp_lib=X.sum(1)
sp_log=np.log1p((X / sp_lib[:,None]) * 1e4)
# z spatial genes
sp_z=(sp_log-sp_log.mean(0))/(sp_log.std(0)+1e-9)
markers={}
for ct in cts:
    inct=meta.cell_type==ct
    mean_in=sc_log.loc[inct].mean(0)
    mean_out=sc_log.loc[~inct].mean(0)
    pct_in=(sc.loc[inct]>0).mean(0)
    pct_out=(sc.loc[~inct]>0).mean(0)
    score=(mean_in-mean_out)*(pct_in+0.1)/(pct_out+0.1)
    top=score.sort_values(ascending=False).head(30).index.tolist()
    markers[ct]=top
    print(ct, top[:10])
# scores
scores=np.zeros((X.shape[0], len(cts)))
for k,ct in enumerate(cts):
    idx=[features.index(g) for g in markers[ct]]
    scores[:,k]=sp_z[:,idx].mean(1)
score_df=pd.DataFrame(scores,index=barcodes,columns=cts)
print('\\nscore corr with nnls fracs')
fr=pd.read_csv('nnls_spot_fractions.csv', index_col=0).loc[barcodes]
for ct in cts:
    print(ct, spearmanr(score_df[ct], fr[ct]).statistic)
# Dominant by marker scores
print('\\nmarker dominant counts')
print(score_df.idxmax(1).value_counts())
# proximity using tumor score high quantiles and ct score high quantiles
pos=pd.read_csv('tissue_positions.csv').set_index('barcode').loc[barcodes]
coords=pos[['array_row','array_col']].astype(float).values
for tq in [0.90,0.925,0.95,0.975]:
    tumor=score_df['Tumor_Core']>=score_df['Tumor_Core'].quantile(tq)
    dist=cdist(coords, coords[tumor]).min(1)
    print('\\ntumor q',tq,'n',tumor.sum(),'dist med',np.median(dist))
    for ct in cts:
        if ct=='Tumor_Core': continue
        for cq in [0.6]:
            mask=score_df[ct]>=score_df[ct].quantile(cq)
            p=mannwhitneyu(dist[mask], dist[~mask], alternative='less').pvalue
            print(ct,'top',1-cq,'n',mask.sum(),'med_in',np.median(dist[mask]),'med_out',np.median(dist[~mask]),'p',p)
PY"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
np.random.seed(1)
fr=pd.read_csv('nnls_spot_fractions.csv', index_col=0)
pos=pd.read_csv('tissue_positions.csv').set_index('barcode').loc[fr.index]
coords=pos[['array_row','array_col']].astype(float).values
cts=list(fr.columns)
for thr in [0.05,0.1,0.2,0.3,0.5]:
    tumor=fr['Tumor_Core'].values>thr
    if tumor.sum()<2: continue
    d=cdist(coords, coords[tumor]).min(1)
    print('\\nTumor thr',thr,'n',tumor.sum())
    for ct in cts:
        if ct=='Tumor_Core': continue
        w=fr[ct].values
        obs=np.average(d, weights=w+1e-12)
        null=[]
        for _ in range(2000):
            wp=np.random.permutation(w)
            null.append(np.average(d, weights=wp+1e-12))
        null=np.array(null)
        p=(np.sum(null<=obs)+1)/(len(null)+1) # closer/smaller than random
        z=(obs-null.mean())/null.std()
        print(f'{ct:18s} obs {obs:.3f} null {null.mean():.3f} z {z:.2f} p {p:.4g}')
PY"
